title: Bakken begins near Copenhagen
description: A spring at Dyrehavsbakken draws crowds and entertainers; it is recognised as the oldest operating amusement park.

title: Promenades Aeriennes opens in Paris
description: Wheeled cars locked to a track with guide rails: the first recognisable roller coaster, inspired by Russian ice slides.

title: Mauch Chunk Switchback Railway built
description: A Pennsylvania coal-hauling gravity railway that later carried tourists for thrills, a model for LaMarcus Thompson.

title: Tivoli Gardens opens in Copenhagen
description: Georg Carstensen's pleasure garden mixes rides, music and lights; Walt Disney later cites it as a model.

title: Thompson's Switchback Railway opens at Coney Island
description: A five-cent gravity ride at just over 6 mph, usually dated as America's first purpose-built roller coaster.

title: World's Columbian Exposition opens in Chicago
description: The Midway Plaisance and the 264 ft Ferris Wheel show that amusements can anchor a fair.

title: Sea Lion Park opens at Coney Island
description: Paul Boyton's enclosed park with a single admission gate sets the amusement-park pattern.

title: Blackpool Pleasure Beach founded
description: William George Bean and John Outhwaite start Britain's defining seaside amusement park.

title: Steeplechase Park opens at Coney Island
description: George Tilyou builds a park around his mechanical racing horses, inspired by the Chicago midway.

title: Wiener Riesenrad built at the Prater
description: Vienna's 64.75 m Ferris wheel becomes a permanent landmark of the European fairground.

title: Kennywood opens as a trolley park
description: The Monongahela Street Railway opens a picnic ground at the end of its Pittsburgh line.

title: Leap-The-Dips opens at Lakemont Park
description: A side-friction figure-eight coaster that is now the oldest standing roller coaster in the world.

title: Luna Park opens at Coney Island
description: Thompson and Dundy light 200,000 bulbs over a fantasy city built around A Trip to the Moon.

title: John Miller's underfriction wheels
description: Wheels under the rail let coasters take steeper drops and sharper curves, opening the 1920s golden age.

title: Liseberg opens in Gothenburg
description: A city-owned park that becomes one of Scandinavia's most visited attractions.

title: Coney Island Cyclone opens
description: Vernon Keenan's wooden coaster survives the Depression and is landmarked in 1988.

title: Knott's Ghost Town opens
description: Walter Knott's replica western town turns a berry stand into a themed destination.

title: Efteling's Fairytale Forest opens
description: Anton Pieck's illustrated fairy tales become walk-through scenes; 222,941 visitors in year one.

title: Walt Disney forms the company that becomes WED Enterprises
description: A private design unit, renamed WED in 1953 and Walt Disney Imagineering in 1986.

title: Disneyland opens
description: A $17 million park with five lands and twenty attractions; the press preview is remembered as Black Sunday.

title: Matterhorn Bobsleds opens
description: Arrow Development builds the first permanent tubular-steel roller coaster.

title: Freedomland U.S.A. opens in the Bronx
description: C. V. Wood's map-shaped park opens; it is bankrupt after the 1964 season.

title: Six Flags Over Texas opens
description: Angus Wynne's park starts the regional theme park chain model.

title: Enchanted Tiki Room opens
description: The first attraction to use Audio-Animatronics figures.

title: New York World's Fair opens with four Disney shows
description: it's a small world, Mr. Lincoln, Carousel of Progress and the Ford Magic Skyway are funded by sponsors.

title: Universal Studio Tour opens in Hollywood
description: The modern tram tour of a working studio, the seed of Universal's parks.

title: Steeplechase Park closes
description: Coney Island's last great park closes after decades of decline.

title: Walt Disney dies
description: Roy O. Disney postpones retirement to finish the Florida project.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean opens
description: Planned as a wax museum, it becomes a boat ride; the last attraction Walt worked on.

title: Omnimover debuts in Adventure Thru Inner Space
description: A continuous chain of swivelling vehicles that aim riders' eyes; patented 1968.

title: Haunted Mansion opens at Disneyland
description: Six years after its facade was finished, the Mansion opens with Doom Buggies and a Pepper's ghost ballroom.

title: Walt Disney World opens
description: Magic Kingdom and two hotels open on land bought in secret through dummy companies.

title: Space Mountain opens at Magic Kingdom
description: An indoor coaster in the dark, built with Arrow Development; Disneyland's version follows in 1977.

title: Corkscrew opens at Knott's Berry Farm
description: Arrow's first modern inverting coaster turns riders upside down twice.

title: Europa-Park opens in Rust
description: The Mack family opens a park to show off its rides; it grows to 18 European-themed areas.

title: The Great American Revolution opens
description: Schwarzkopf and Stengel bring back the vertical loop with a clothoid shape.

title: Alton Towers opens as a theme park
description: A pay-one-price park with the Corkscrew coaster on a stately-home estate.

title: EPCOT Center opens
description: Walt's city of tomorrow becomes a park of Future World pavilions and World Showcase.

title: Tokyo Disneyland opens
description: The first Disney park abroad, owned by Oriental Land Company under licence.

title: Magnum XL-200 opens at Cedar Point
description: The first coaster over 200 ft starts the coaster wars.

title: Universal Studios Florida opens
description: Jaws, Kongfrontation and Earthquake break down on opening; Universal issues return vouchers.

title: Euro Disney opens
description: Attendance misses targets and debt reaches about $3 billion before a 1994 rescue.

title: Batman: The Ride opens
description: B&M's first inverted coaster, later cloned worldwide.

title: TEA creates the Thea Awards
description: The Themed Entertainment Association starts peer awards for outstanding projects.

title: Tower of Terror opens
description: Otis-built cabs are pulled down faster than gravity at Disney-MGM Studios.

title: Indiana Jones Adventure opens
description: The Enhanced Motion Vehicle debuts behind a half-mile themed queue.

title: Flight of Fear opens
description: Premier Rides' twin coasters are the first launched by linear induction motors.

title: Superman: The Escape opens
description: An LSM shuttle reaches 100 mph and 415 ft, the first coaster over 400 ft.

title: Disney's Animal Kingdom opens
description: Joe Rohde's park around the 145 ft Tree of Life.

title: Merlin Entertainments founded
description: Nick Varney's management buyout of Vardon Attractions.

title: Islands of Adventure opens with Spider-Man
description: Motion bases on a track plus 3D screens define the media dark ride; Thea Award in 2000.

title: Millennium Force opens
description: The first giga coaster, 310 ft, with a cable lift.

title: Pooh's Hunny Hunt opens
description: Tokyo Disneyland's trackless dark ride, the system later used in Mystic Manor.

title: Hypersonic XLC opens
description: S&S's first compressed-air launch coaster.

title: Tokyo DisneySea opens
description: Seven ports of call; 10 million guests in 307 days.

title: Arrow Dynamics files for bankruptcy
description: S&S buys the assets in 2002, ending the company that built the Matterhorn.

title: Xcelerator opens
description: Intamin's first hydraulic launch: 0 to 82 mph in 2.3 seconds.

title: Top Thrill Dragster opens
description: The first strata coaster, 420 ft and 120 mph.

title: Kingda Ka opens
description: 456 ft and 128 mph: the tallest coaster until its 2024 closure.

title: Six Flags New Orleans operates for the last time
description: Hurricane Katrina floods the park eight days later; it never reopens.

title: Hong Kong Disneyland opens
description: A 52/48 government-Disney joint venture designed with feng shui input.

title: Expedition Everest opens
description: A $100 million Vekoma coaster with switch tracks and a 25 ft Yeti.

title: Hard Rock Park opens
description: The Myrtle Beach park files for bankruptcy in September of the same year.

title: Wizarding World of Harry Potter opens
description: Forbidden Journey's KUKA arms debut; Islands of Adventure attendance rises 29% that year.

title: Formula Rossa opens
description: A 240 km/h hydraulic launch at Ferrari World, the fastest coaster until 2025.

title: New Texas Giant reopens
description: The first RMC I-Box conversion of a wooden coaster.

title: Transformers: The Ride opens in Singapore
description: Oceaneering vehicles with six-axis motion bases; Hollywood and Orlando follow.

title: Mystic Manor opens
description: Hong Kong Disneyland's trackless manor avoids ghosts for cultural reasons; TEA award in November.

title: Chimelong Ocean Kingdom grand opening
description: The Zhuhai park grows to 12.6 million guests by 2024.

title: Shanghai Disneyland opens
description: No Main Street, a Mickey Avenue, and the largest Disney castle.

title: Defunctland premieres
description: Kevin Perjurer's documentary series on closed attractions starts on YouTube.

title: Pandora and Flight of Passage open
description: A link-chair flying simulator with 10K 60 fps stereo media.

title: Symbolica opens at Efteling
description: A EUR 35 million ETF trackless ride with three selectable routes.

title: Steel Vengeance opens
description: Mean Streak becomes the first hyper-hybrid, with four inversions.

title: Rise of the Resistance opens
description: An 18-minute multi-system ride launched with boarding-group virtual queues.

title: Walt Disney World closes for the pandemic
description: The resort stays shut until July 11, 2020; Disneyland closes March 14 and reopens April 30, 2021.

title: Magic Kingdom reopens with reservations
description: Phased reopening begins; park entry now requires a dated reservation.

title: Super Nintendo World opens in Osaka
description: The Power-Up Band wristband turns a land into a playable game.

title: Disneyland reopens
description: After more than a year closed, the original park reopens.

title: Universal Beijing Resort opens
description: A joint venture 70% owned by a Beijing state enterprise.

title: Kingda Ka closes
description: The tallest coaster closes; its tower is imploded on February 28, 2025.

title: Universal Epic Universe opens
description: Five worlds around Celestial Park, including Super Nintendo World and Ministry of Magic.

title: Rowling signs a letter of intent with Disney
description: A Harry Potter area for the Magic Kingdom is agreed in principle; Disney later withdraws.

title: Universal announces the Wizarding World
description: A 20-acre Harry Potter land for Islands of Adventure, licensed from Warner Bros.

title: Disney agrees to buy Lucasfilm
description: A $4.05 billion deal that names theme parks among its uses for Star Wars.

title: Diagon Alley opens
description: The second Wizarding World land, linked to Hogsmeade by the Hogwarts Express.

title: Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge opens at Disneyland
description: A 14-acre land set on the planet Batuu; Walt Disney World's opens on August 29.
